title: C. Tokitsukaze and Two Colorful Tapes

legend: Tokitsukaze has two colorful tapes. There are n%%ZSMJ0%% distinct colors, numbered 1%%ZSMJ1%% through n%%ZSMJ2%%, and each color appears exactly once on each of the two tapes. Denote the color of the i%%ZSMJ3%%-th position of the first tape as cai%%ZSMJ4%%, and the color of the i%%ZSMJ5%%-th position of the second tape as cbi%%ZSMJ6%%.

Now Tokitsukaze wants to select each color an integer value from 1%%ZSMJ7%% to n%%ZSMJ8%%, distinct for all the colors. After that she will put down the color values in each colored position on the tapes. Denote the number of the i%%ZSMJ9%%-th position of the first tape as numai%%ZSMJ10%%, and the number of the i%%ZSMJ11%%-th position of the second tape as numbi%%ZSMJ12%%.

For example, for the above picture, assuming that the color red has value x%%ZSMJ13%% (1≤x≤n%%ZSMJ14%%), it appears at the 1%%ZSMJ15%%-st position of the first tape and the 3%%ZSMJ16%%-rd position of the second tape, so numa1=numb3=x%%ZSMJ17%%.
Note that each color i%%ZSMJ18%% from 1%%ZSMJ19%% to n%%ZSMJ20%% should have a distinct value, and the same color which appears in both tapes has the same value.
After labeling each color, the beauty of the two tapes is calculated as n∑i=1|numai−numbi|.%%ZSMJ21%%
Please help Tokitsukaze to find the highest possible beauty.
input: The first contains a single positive integer t%%ZSMJ22%% (1≤t≤104%%ZSMJ23%%) — the number of test cases.
For each test case, the first line contains a single integer n%%ZSMJ24%% (1≤n≤105%%ZSMJ25%%) — the number of colors.
The second line contains n%%ZSMJ26%% integers ca1,ca2,…,can%%ZSMJ27%% (1≤cai≤n%%ZSMJ28%%) — the color of each position of the first tape. It is guaranteed that ca%%ZSMJ29%% is a permutation.
The third line contains n%%ZSMJ30%% integers cb1,cb2,…,cbn%%ZSMJ31%% (1≤cbi≤n%%ZSMJ32%%) — the color of each position of the second tape. It is guaranteed that cb%%ZSMJ33%% is a permutation.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ34%% over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105%%ZSMJ35%%.
output: For each test case, print a single integer — the highest possible beauty.
